newsitem.title: USA: Worst US credit card cases involve few banks - study.
newsitem.headline: Worst US credit card cases involve few banks - study.

text.p: Amid rising concern about growth in credit card delinquencies, a new study by a bank research firm suggests the worst problems are concentrated at a few institutions, many of which specialize in card loans.

"It appears that the minority of people who are poor credit risks have gravitated to a small number of card offerers," said the study by Veribanc Inc of Wakefield, Mass, which based its research on Federal Reserve Board data.

"This process resembles insurance industry experience with 'adverse selection' -- a problem that is likely to be resolved as bank card companies refine their credit screening and solicitation programs," the study added.
Veribanc found that a total of 157 banks had credit card debt outstanding exceeding $100 million per bank.
"These banks account for 96 percent of all banks' credit card debt and 97 percent of all seriously delinquent credit card debt," the study said.

Of those institutions, the delinquency rates are the highest among those for which credit card debt accounts for most of their lending. Those banks as a group held more than half of all bank card debts and nearly two thirds of the serious delinquencies.
In addition, the study found a large amount of credit card debt and serious card delinquencies at companies that operate credit card programs through subsidiary or affiliated banks.

"Twenty-eight companies that operate credit card programs through subsidiary or affiliated banks account for 54 percent of all credit card debt and 78 percent of all seriously delinquent card debt," the study said.
"Banks in these groups, taken together, have a serious credit card delinquency rate of 2.78 percent, almost half again the national average," it added.
Among the specialized companies with the highest serious delinquency rates were Ford Motor Co, Dillard Department Stores and Dean Witter, Discover & Co, the study said.
The rate of serious card delinquencies as a percentage of outstanding card debt was 4.35 percent at Ford, 3.78 percent at Dillard and 3.69 percent Dean Witter, Discover, Veribanc said.
